examples.title: Merge two selected nodes
examples.code:
# Use the first two selected nodes as the Merge inputs.
nodes = nuke.selectedNodes()
background = nodes[0]
foreground = nodes[1]

merge = nuke.createNode("Merge2")
merge.setInput(0, foreground)
merge.setInput(1, background)
merge["operation"].setValue("over")
